purpose: P2b — pre-fix native planning baseline (native/Python planning parity plan)

binary.backend_note: CUDA build, not CPU and not Vulkan. On this Blackwell box a CPU build plans ~1 utterance / 30s (a ~7h corpus run) and PERFORMANCE.md 2 records Vulkan collapsing to CPU speed on Blackwell. S2's post-fix run MUST use the same backend: greedy argmax over different FP accumulation can flip a near-tie, so a backend change would be indistinguishable from the prompt change being measured.
